from pathlib import Path
import dask
print('workspace import:', dask.__file__)
assert Path(dask.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path.cwd().resolve())
from dask.utils import Dispatch
import decimal
class Lazy(decimal.Decimal):pass
class Eager(Lazy):pass
foo=Dispatch()
@foo.register(Eager)
def eager(value):return "eager"
def lazy(value):return "lazy"
@foo.register_lazy("decimal")
def register_decimal():foo.register(decimal.Decimal,lazy)
print(foo.dispatch(Lazy),foo(Lazy(1)))
assert foo.dispatch(Lazy) is lazy and foo(Lazy(1))=="lazy"
assert foo(Eager(1))=="eager"
